model: official JoyAI-Video-Edit 0811 streaming RV2V + experimental first-VAE-latent endpoint anchor
official_input_mode: RV2V: complete post-t* source video via frame_meta/JPEG + actual Stage2 terminal ref_image
experimental_input_condition: first output VAE time latent is clamped to VAE-encoded actual Stage2 terminal image at each official Euler scheduler next-sigma; all later chunks use unmodified official RV2V; CUDA graph disabled
native_first_frame_postprocessing: none; no decoded-frame replacement or pixel overlay
spatial_limit: official VAE requires dimensions divisible by 24; 832x480 endpoint is bicubic-resized to 840x480 before anchor VAE encode and output
prompt: At the fixed new camera viewpoint shown by the supplied Stage 2 terminal frame, continue the exact order of person and object actions from the supplied source video after the highlight frame. Maintain the same person's identity, clothing, pose continuity, background geometry and lighting. The camera must stay stationary at this new viewpoint. Do not keep the action frozen, invent different motion, change the person, move the camera, or rebuild the scene.
sampling_audit_note: Archived server log ties recording1791893073_1 to actual endpoint RGB hash, two first-chunk native sampling pins and zero final latent delta; later chunks remain official RV2V.
task_completion_note: Do not infer task pass from a valid 81-frame video, hash match, or low first-frame error. Inspect action sequence, identity, background and static camera separately.
